widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description: 15-second narrative emotional short film, montage with multiple shot transitions, preserve the woman’s facial features, long black hair and white spaghetti-strap dress from reference image, cool-toned overcast seaside, no warm light, no sunset or dusk, soft diffused light, subtle film grain, cinematic framing. [0-3s] Medium close-up: she grips her skirt tightly, eyelashes trembling, wistful emotion hidden in eyes, sea wind tangles her hair. [3-6s] Cut to medium shot: she walks slowly toward the sea, shallow waves wash over her feet. [6-9s] Cut to insert montage: surf breaks repeatedly on sand, tide recedes and leaves water marks. [9-12s] Cut to wide shot: her lone figure on the vast shore, small yet resolute against the ocean. [12-15s] Cut to profile close-up: she tilts her face slightly into the wind, no tears, restrained emotion with quiet power of reconciliation. Breathing rhythm for cuts, stable face without distortion, clean frame, subtle sense of inner struggle.
overall_soundscape: rolling layered ocean waves, slightly heavier wind rustle, occasional surge of tide, spacious and weighty.
non_diegetic_music: narrative melancholic instrumental, piano lead, strings slowly swell halfway through, emotion builds gradually without bursting, restrained and powerful, aligned with montage cuts.
